items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I am the grandson of Lucie Price and Madison Price.

ctx.x: I am Andrew Blakeney, birth dated June 10, 1898, born Quitman, Mississippi. I am the son of Thomas and Anna Lucie Price Blakeney. I am the grandson of Lucie Price and Madison Price. I don't recall my paternal grandparents.

My grandmother was brought to Mississippi from Virginia by some people as a slave in her teens. Years later, she was permitted to marry the house slave by the name of Luke. Twelve children resulted from that union. My mother, Anna Lucie, was the eleventh child. My mother--the two youngest--were sent to Meridian to school by the big city just fifteen miles north of Enterprise.
